name: Rock
overview: The Bible presents God as the unchanging and reliable Rock, a symbol of perfect justice, truth, and strength, as affirmed in Deuteronomy 32:4 and 2 Samuel 22:32. This imagery extends to God's provision and care, demonstrated when Moses struck the rock at Horeb to bring forth water for the thirsty Israelites (Exodus 17:6) and when God supplied sustenance like honey and oil from the flinty rock (Deuteronomy 32:13). The metaphor also reminds believers of their origin and dependence on God, the Rock who formed them, urging remembrance and faithfulness (Deuteronomy 32:18).
